command: /bin/zsh -lc 'for f in .agents/skills/rsp/SKILL.md .agents/skills/rsp-shape/SKILL.md .agents/skills/rsp-design/SKILL.md AGENTS.md client/AGENTS.md client/CONTEXT.md .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md; do echo "### $f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' .agents/skills/rsp-design/references/module-seams.md && printf '\\n--- focus ---\\n' && find .rsp/focus.d -maxdepth 1 -type f -print -exec sed -n '1,120p' {} \\; && printf '\\n--- candidate files ---\\n' && rg --files client | rg 'device|discover|receiver|desktop|runtime|test' && printf '\\n--- references ---\\n' && rg -n -i 'projectDeviceEvent|device discovery|device event|connected|discover' client --glob '"'!**/node_modules/**'"'"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,200p' client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts && printf '\\n--- client tree ---\\n' && find client -maxdepth 4 -type f | sort && printf '\\n--- package metadata ---\\n' && find client -maxdepth 4 -name package.json -print -exec sed -n '1,200p' {} \\; && printf '\\n--- workspace config ---\\n' && rg -n 'device-discovery|packages/' client/pnpm-workspace.yaml client/package.json client/vitest.config.* client/**/vite.config.* 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort && printf '\\n--- git diff ---\\n' && git status --short && git diff -- .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' package.json && printf '\\n--- focused test ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' test/device-discovery.test.mjs && printf '\\n--- RSP focused check ---\\n' && npx --no-install rsp check --focused"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md && npx --no-install rsp check --focused && git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/rsp/SKILL.md && sed -n '1,300p' .agents/skills/rsp-implement/SKILL.md && sed -n '1,260p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,260p' client/AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,280p' client/CONTEXT.md && sed -n '1,360p' .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md"
/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && rg --files client | rg 'device-discovery|package.json|pnpm-workspace|vitest|test' && find .rsp/focus.d -maxdepth 2 -type f -print"

/bin/zsh -lc "find client -maxdepth 5 -type f -print | sort && sed -n '1,220p' client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f \\( -name 'package.json' -o -name 'pnpm-workspace.yaml' -o -name 'vitest.config.*' \\) -print"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' package.json && find . -maxdepth 5 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -print | sort && git diff -- .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' test/device-discovery.test.mjs && sed -n '1,220p' .rsp/specs/design.md && npx --no-install rsp check --focused"
/bin/zsh -lc 'mise exec -- pnpm test -- device-discovery'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts && git status --short'
/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'CONTEXT-MAP.md' -g 'CONTEXT.md' -g 'SKILL.md' -g 'rsp-rules.md' -g '*' .rsp/focus.d 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,160p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' .agents/skills/rsp-review/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- selected change ---\\n' && sed -n '1,320p' .rsp/focus.d/device-discovery-boundary && printf '\\n--- project authorities ---\\n' && (test -f CONTEXT-MAP.md && sed -n '1,220p' CONTEXT-MAP.md || true) && (test -f client/AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,260p' client/AGENTS.md || true) && (test -f client/CONTEXT.md && sed -n '1,260p' client/CONTEXT.md || true) && (test -f .rsp/rsp-rules.md && sed -n '1,260p' .rsp/rsp-rules.md || true)"

/bin/zsh -lc "ls -la .rsp/focus.d && file .rsp/focus.d/device-discovery-boundary && rg --files .rsp client test | sed -n '1,240p' && printf '\\n--- RSP status ---\\n' && npx --no-install rsp status && printf '\\n--- explicit scoped diff ---\\n' && git diff --no-ext-diff -- .rsp/focus.d/device-discovery-boundary client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts test/device-discovery.test.mjs && printf '\\n--- scoped untracked status ---\\n' && git status --short -- .rsp/focus.d/device-discovery-boundary client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts test/device-discovery.test.mjs"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- selected Change ---' && sed -n '1,320p' .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- relevant specs ---' && sed -n '1,220p' .rsp/specs/INDEX.md && sed -n '1,320p' .rsp/specs/design.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- explicit requested-scope diff ---' && git diff --no-ext-diff -- .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts test/device-discovery.test.mjs && printf '%s\\n' '--- requested-scope status ---' && git status --short -- .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts test/device-discovery.test.mjs && printf '%s\\n' '--- reviewed code and test ---' && nl -ba client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts && nl -ba test/device-discovery.test.mjs && printf '%s\\n' '--- comparison-point code ---' && git show HEAD:client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- public-seam consumers ---' && rg -n --glob '"'!node_modules'"' --glob '"'!*.lock'"' 'projectDeviceEvent|device-discovery' client test && printf '%s\\n' '--- focused verification ---' && mise exec -- pnpm test -- device-discovery && printf '%s\\n' '--- whitespace check for reviewed paths ---' && git diff --check -- .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts test/device-discovery.test.mjs"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' .agents/skills/rsp/SKILL.md && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'CONTEXT-MAP.md' -g 'CONTEXT.md' -g 'device-discovery-boundary.md' -g 'device-discovery.test.mjs' -g 'index.ts' -g 'device-discovery-boundary.md' | sort"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' client/AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,260p' client/CONTEXT.md && npx --no-install rsp status --json && npx --no-install rsp show --focused --json && sed -n '1,300p' .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md && sed -n '1,240p' client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts && sed -n '1,260p' test/device-discovery.test.mjs && if [ -f docs/architecture/device-discovery-boundary.md ]; then sed -n '1,320p' docs/architecture/device-discovery-boundary.md; else echo 'DOC_ABSENT'; fi"

/bin/zsh -lc "npx --no-install rsp check --focused && sed -n '1,260p' .rsp/specs/design.md && rg --files .rsp/specs/decisions docs/architecture 2>/dev/null | sort && git status --short && git diff --no-ext-diff --check -- docs/architecture/device-discovery-boundary.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' docs/architecture/device-discovery-boundary.md && git diff --no-ext-diff --check -- docs/architecture/device-discovery-boundary.md && git diff --no-ext-diff -- docs/architecture/device-discovery-boundary.md && git status --short"
